# Third-party skill sources

Attribution material for skills vendored into `.claude/skills/` from external
repositories. The actual skill packages live in `.claude/skills/<name>/`;
this directory only holds each source repo's `LICENSE` and original README
(as `SOURCE_README.md`) for reference.

| Source repo | Skills under `.claude/skills/` |
|---|---|
| https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill | `banner-design/`, `brand/`, `design/`, `design-system/`, `slides/`, `ui-styling/`, `ui-ux-pro-max/` |
| https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills/frontend-design | `frontend-design/` (bundles its own `LICENSE.txt`) |
| https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill | `brandkit/`, `brutalist-skill/`, `gpt-tasteskill/`, `image-to-code-skill/`, `imagegen-frontend-mobile/`, `imagegen-frontend-web/`, `minimalist-skill/`, `output-skill/`, `redesign-skill/`, `soft-skill/`, `stitch-skill/`, `taste-skill/`, `taste-skill-v1/` |
| https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable | `impeccable/` |
